_why: The boxed components `summrise setup` FETCHES (grilling Q4, 2026-09-23). The npm package carries none of them, and until now setup verified none of them either: a worker serving different bytes would have been staged without complaint. publish-release.sh copies this file into version.json's `components` block, and setup refuses a mismatch. cloudflared's sha256 is CROSS-CHECKED against agent/src/tunnel.rs (CLOUDFLARED_SHA256) at publish time -- the agent re-checks that one at run time and the two must not drift. REPLACE A COMPONENT => UPDATE ITS PIN HERE IN THE SAME COMMIT, or every fresh install fails closed (loudly, which is the point).
_how_to_replace: cloudflared: a PINNED upstream asset, proxied by the worker's route. The pin lives in agent/src/tunnel.rs; move it there and here together (publish-release.sh refuses a publish when they disagree).
electron: STAGED IN R2. Fetch the pinned upstream asset once, then `wrangler r2 object put summrise-temp-files/electron-win32-x64.zip --file=<zip> --remote`, sha256 it and pin it here.

playwright: STAGED IN R2, and NOTHING IN THIS REPO BUILDS IT -- which is why its route answered 502 for a day after the rename and nobody noticed. It is the contents of <install>\components\playwright on a device that has a working bundle: node.exe (the Windows node the CLI spawns), node_modules/{@playwright/mcp,playwright-core} (versions in <install>\etc\boxed-versions.json) and probe.js. Rebuild it by zipping that folder (the archive's ROOT must be the `playwright` folder, which Expand-Archive into components\ expects), stage it in R2 the same way, and pin the sha256 here. A real producer script is still owed.
